publicationRule: Only opportunities where at least one Toppenish High School student may qualify. Confirmed opportunities use current sponsor information and a verified current-cycle deadline or rolling status. Recurring opportunities may appear as tentative planning cards—even when return is uncertain—when a dated sponsor or school-hosted prior-cycle source shows the opportunity existed. Tentative cards must identify the source cycle, clearly state that the opening, deadline, award, eligibility, and return are not guaranteed, and must never create calendar events. When a person verifies the new cycle and enters the current opening and deadline, the finder automatically changes the card to Open & accepting. Nightly checks preserve records and flag source changes for review; they never guess or confirm a deadline.

scholarships.expectedWindow: Applications open yearly on December 1 and close on the last day of February. Plan for February 28, 2027 and confirm the new cycle after it opens.
scholarships.whyFit: This is one of the strongest local opportunities for Toppenish students planning YVC because one application provides access to many scholarships.
scholarships.needs: YVC scholarship application, unofficial transcript, at least two references, education plans, and the current written responses or supporting information.

scholarships.name: Washington Apple Education Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.award: One application matches students to many renewable awards; WAEF awards more than $1 million annually
scholarships.eligibility: Washington seniors or college students with family employment or ownership ties to the apple, cherry, or pear industry. Students without family ties may qualify through an eligible vocational/technical program or a planned career supporting the tree-fruit industry.
scholarships.expectedWindow: WAEF traditionally reopens applications in the fall. The prior cycle was due March 2, 2026; confirm the 2027 opening and deadline when released.
scholarships.whyFit: A high-value match for many Toppenish families connected to orchards, warehouses, packing, refrigeration, electrical work, IT, HVAC, machinery, or other tree-fruit businesses.
scholarships.needs: Online application, family employment or career-path information, transcript, recommendation, work and leadership history, short answers, and an essay. Current requirements may change.

scholarships.name: Eastern Washington University Scholarship Consideration
scholarships.award: Automatic consideration for EWU scholarships; awards vary
scholarships.eligibility: Students applying to Eastern Washington University who meet the current admission and individual scholarship requirements. Prior guidance listed a 2.8 GPA for the general scholarship process, but students should use EWU's current requirements.
scholarships.expectedWindow: EWU's prior scholarship priority date was February 1, and applicants who applied by that date received automatic scholarship consideration. Confirm the 2027 priority date and current GPA rules.
scholarships.whyFit: Toppenish students considering EWU should apply early because university scholarship consideration is connected to the EWU admission process.
scholarships.needs: EWU admission application, transcript, and any scholarship or Honors materials requested for the student's program. Confirm whether a separate scholarship application is required.

scholarships.name: Energizing Tomorrow's Leaders Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Graduating seniors attending school in Yakima County who plan a U.S. accredited four-year, two-year, or certificate program. All eligible majors may apply, with preference for energy or STEM interests.
scholarships.expectedWindow: The 2026 Yakima County application was due April 10. Plan for an early-2027 opening and confirm that Yakima County remains eligible before applying.
scholarships.whyFit: Every Toppenish High School senior meets the 2026 geographic rule because Toppenish is in Yakima County; STEM interest is preferred but not required.
scholarships.needs: Online application, school and activity history, personal statement, a short video about how renewable energy affects the student's future, and proof of enrollment if selected.

scholarships.name: Alpha Delta Kappa Toppenish Scholarship
scholarships.award: $1,000 in the prior posted cycle
scholarships.eligibility: The prior local award was for female Toppenish High School seniors showing citizenship, leadership, academics, service, and plans for further education or training, with extra consideration for a future educator.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Prior GEAR UP information listed a May 2, 2025 deadline. The 2027 award, amount, requirements, and application are not guaranteed; check with the THS College & Career Center in spring 2027.
scholarships.whyFit: This is specifically designed for Toppenish High School students, making it a high-priority local opportunity if the chapter offers it again.
scholarships.needs: Ask the THS College & Career Center for the current paper or digital application. Prepare a transcript, activity/service history, education plans, and any requested recommendation or essay.

scholarships.name: Toppenish Lions Club Scholarship
scholarships.award: Up to three $1,000 awards in the prior posted cycle
scholarships.eligibility: The prior local award was for college-bound Toppenish High School seniors and considered financial need, GPA, school activities, and community service.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Prior GEAR UP information listed a May 12, 2025 deadline. The 2027 award and deadline are not guaranteed; check with the THS College & Career Center in spring 2027.
scholarships.whyFit: This prior award was reserved for Toppenish seniors, so it may offer much better odds than a national scholarship if it returns.
scholarships.needs: Prior requirements included a letter of application plus information about financial need, academics, activities, and community service. Obtain the current application from THS.

scholarships.name: Toppenish-Wapato Dollars for Scholars
scholarships.award: $2,500 in the prior posted cycle
scholarships.eligibility: Students connected to the Toppenish or Wapato communities who have a postsecondary plan at an accredited institution and can demonstrate community service and citizenship. Current criteria may vary.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Prior GEAR UP information listed a May 5, 2025 deadline. Students can create a Dollars for Scholars profile now, then confirm the 2027 local application and deadline.
scholarships.whyFit: This hometown scholarship specifically supports students from the Toppenish and Wapato communities.
scholarships.needs: Create a Student and Parent Login profile, complete education and community-service information, and submit any current transcript, references, essays, or local matching questions.

scholarships.name: Yakima Valley Construction Federation Scholarship
scholarships.award: Award amount varies
scholarships.eligibility: Central Washington high school graduates preparing for a construction-industry career and attending an eligible college, university, or technical school. Students must confirm the current geographic and enrollment requirements.
scholarships.expectedWindow: The 2026 listing opened February 1 and closed April 1. Use those dates for planning only and confirm the 2027 application with the sponsor or THS College & Career Center.
scholarships.whyFit: Toppenish students pursuing construction trades or construction-related college programs may qualify as Central Washington graduates.
scholarships.needs: Current sponsor application, construction career and school plans, transcript or enrollment information, and any requested supporting documents.

scholarships.name: Yakama Nation Higher Education Scholarship
scholarships.award: Scholarships and grants; amounts vary
scholarships.eligibility: Enrolled members of the Confederated Tribes and Bands of the Yakama Nation who have graduated from high school or earned a GED and are admitted to a regionally accredited college or university. Current program rules must be confirmed.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Prior GEAR UP information listed a July 1, 2025 deadline. Confirm the 2027 deadline and obtain the current tribal scholarship application directly from Yakama Nation Higher Education.
scholarships.whyFit: This is a highly relevant local source of support for enrolled Yakama students and is administered in Toppenish.
scholarships.needs: Current Yakama Nation application, tribal enrollment verification, high school diploma or GED information, admission to an accredited institution, transcript, financial-aid documents, and any program forms.

scholarships.name: P.E.O. STAR Scholarship
scholarships.award: $2,500 one-time scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Chapter nomination required: women in their final year of high school, age 20 or younger at year-end, with a 3.0+ unweighted GPA, U.S. or Canadian citizenship or permanent residency, leadership and service, and plans for accredited U.S. or Canadian postsecondary study.
scholarships.gate: A local P.E.O. chapter must nominate the student; students cannot apply independently.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Local P.E.O. chapters may submit one recommendation between August 15 and October 15, 2026. Students cannot apply directly; a nominated student then has 30 days to submit her materials.
scholarships.whyFit: A Toppenish senior may qualify, but she must first be interviewed and formally nominated by a local P.E.O. chapter. Ask Mr. Barragan or counseling for help connecting with a chapter before October 15.
scholarships.needs: A local P.E.O. chapter nomination, a 700-word original essay, two recommendations, activity and service information, and an unofficial transcript through junior year.

scholarships.name: Stephen J. Brady Stop Hunger Scholarship
scholarships.award: $10,000 scholarship plus a $5,000 grant for a hunger-relief charity
scholarships.eligibility: Students ages 5–25 who have made a meaningful, creative, and sustained impact fighting hunger or food insecurity in their community.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now — the annual application period runs August 20–October 20.
scholarships.whyFit: Toppenish students who organize food drives, pantry work, meal programs, food recovery, advocacy, or other hunger-relief efforts may qualify.
scholarships.needs: An online application describing the student's hunger-relief work, leadership, creativity, community impact, and the charity connected to the project. Review the current official rules before submitting.

scholarships.name: Hagan Scholarship
scholarships.award: Up to $7,500 per semester for up to 8 semesters, plus college-start and study-abroad benefits
scholarships.eligibility: Class of 2027 seniors at a U.S. high school with a 3.50+ unweighted GPA, parents' 2025 adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less, plans for an eligible four-year college, and the ability to complete 240 paid work hours from January 1–September 1, 2027.
scholarships.expectedWindow: The fall application opens September 1 and closes December 1, 2026. A second application window is scheduled for January 15–March 15, 2027.
scholarships.whyFit: A strong national option for a Toppenish senior who meets the GPA and income rules, plans an eligible four-year college, and can complete the required paid work hours. Community college, junior college, and online institutions are not eligible.
scholarships.needs: Online application, current high school transcript, an unsealed recommendation letter, household-income information, four-year college plans, and a plan for the required paid work hours. Finalists may need FAFSA or citizenship documents.

scholarships.name: Elks Legacy Awards
scholarships.award: $6,000 ($1,500 per year for four years)
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors who are the child, stepchild, grandchild, step-grandchild, or legal ward of an eligible living Elks member in good standing. Great-grandchildren are not eligible.
scholarships.gate: Applicant must be the child, stepchild, grandchild, step-grandchild, or legal ward of a living Elks member in good standing.
scholarships.expectedWindow: The 2027 application opens September 1, 2026 and closes February 1, 2027 at 11:59 a.m. Pacific.
scholarships.whyFit: This is separate from the Elks Most Valuable Student scholarship already posted. A Toppenish senior may qualify through a parent or grandparent's Elks membership; the sponsor's membership rules still apply.
scholarships.needs: Online application, the Elk sponsor's name, lodge number and membership number, a transcript, and the current essays. ACT and SAT scores are not required for the 2027 contest.

scholarships.name: NHS Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Class of 2027 seniors who are active NHS members in good standing, have a verified NHS student account, and plan to attend an accredited U.S. college, university, military institute, or trade school.
scholarships.expectedWindow: The application opens September 3 and closes November 20, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern.
scholarships.whyFit: Toppenish NHS seniors can apply after their adviser verifies their NHS account. There is no limit to the number of applicants from a chapter.
scholarships.needs: A verified NHS student account, detailed scholarship, service, leadership and character activities, NHS adviser certification, and one recommendation from a non-adviser, non-family adult.

scholarships.name: The Gates Scholarship
scholarships.award: Last-dollar support for remaining full cost of attendance
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors who are Pell-eligible U.S. citizens or permanent residents with a 3.3+ cumulative weighted GPA and plans for a full-time, four-year degree at an accredited U.S. nonprofit college or university.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now; deadline September 15, 2026.
scholarships.whyFit: A high-value match for Toppenish seniors with substantial financial need, strong academics, and leadership. The scholarship covers remaining costs after other aid and the Student Aid Index.
scholarships.needs: Online profile/application, academic and activity history, financial-aid planning, and the current supporting documents requested in each selection phase.

scholarships.name: NCWIT Aspirations in Computing High School Award
scholarships.award: National and regional awards; prize amounts vary
scholarships.eligibility: Students in grades 9–12 who are active or interested in computing/technology, are age 13+, join the free AiC Community, and attend school in the U.S. or an eligible U.S. territory or base.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Application opens September 1 and closes October 27, 2026 at 10:00 p.m. Eastern. An optional educator endorsement is due November 5.
scholarships.whyFit: A strong fit for Toppenish students building skills in coding, robotics, technology, engineering, digital media, or other computing-related work. The free community membership is required before applying.
scholarships.needs: AiC Community membership, parent/guardian approval if under 18, activities and experiences in computing, short application responses, and ideally an educator endorsement.

scholarships.name: Women in Aviation International Scholarships
scholarships.award: Multiple aviation and aerospace scholarships; amounts vary
scholarships.eligibility: Current WAI members pursuing aviation or aerospace education/training. Applicants must be WAI members by August 30, 2026 and meet the requirements of each individual scholarship.
scholarships.gate: Applicant must be a Women in Aviation International member by August 30, 2026.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now; the WAI2027 cycle closes September 1, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
scholarships.whyFit: Open to students of any gender. A strong option for Toppenish students interested in aviation, flight training, aircraft maintenance, aerospace, dispatch, or related careers who can join WAI before the membership deadline.
scholarships.needs: Current WAI membership, the application, and the documents required for each specific aviation/aerospace scholarship.

scholarships.name: Great Clips Scholarship Program
scholarships.award: Up to $5,000 per scholarship; more than $100,000 awarded annually
scholarships.eligibility: High school and post-high-school students in the U.S. or Canada who are enrolled in a cosmetology or barbering program.
scholarships.gate: Applicant must already be enrolled in a cosmetology or barbering program.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Applications are open year-round; the fall award deadline is September 1, 2026.
scholarships.whyFit: A direct trade-school option for a Toppenish student preparing for cosmetology or barbering.
scholarships.needs: Short online application and the current materials requested by Great Clips; confirm whether the current cycle requires an essay.

scholarships.name: Leaders Save Lives Scholarship Program
scholarships.award: $1,000–$2,500 scholarship drawings for student blood-drive hosts
scholarships.eligibility: High school or college students who organize an American Red Cross blood drive during a program period and collect at least 25 pints of blood.
scholarships.gate: Applicant must organize an eligible Red Cross blood drive and collect at least 25 pints.
scholarships.expectedWindow: The summer program runs Memorial Day–Labor Day. A student must host the drive and collect 25+ pints to enter the scholarship drawing; winter opportunities also run December 15–January 15.
scholarships.whyFit: A practical leadership and service option for Toppenish students who can organize a Red Cross blood drive with school or community support.
scholarships.needs: Contact the American Red Cross to schedule a qualifying blood drive, create a recruitment team, collect at least 25 pints, and follow the current program terms.

scholarships.name: Hereford Youth Foundation of America Fall Scholarships
scholarships.organization: Hereford Youth Foundation of America / National Junior Hereford Association
scholarships.award: More than $150,000 across multiple fall scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Current National Junior Hereford Association members pursuing postsecondary education; individual awards have different requirements and some include trade or technical training.
scholarships.gate: Applicant must be a current National Junior Hereford Association member.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now; the fall scholarship application deadline is September 1, 2026.
scholarships.whyFit: A high-value fit for a Toppenish student involved in Hereford cattle, FFA, or the beef industry who is an NJHA member.
scholarships.needs: NJHA membership, the current HYFA application, education plans, activity and leadership history, and each award's requested supporting materials.

scholarships.name: NAAA Support Scholarship Media Contest
scholarships.award: $2,000 first-place and $1,000 second-place educational scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors or students pursuing education beyond high school who are sponsored by a current NAAA member; the sponsor's membership must have been obtained by June 15, 2026.
scholarships.gate: A current NAAA member who joined by June 15, 2026 must sponsor the applicant.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now; deadline September 8, 2026. Students need an eligible NAAA member sponsor before applying.
scholarships.whyFit: A niche but real opportunity for a Toppenish senior interested in agricultural aviation, crop-dusting, flying, mechanics, or the agriculture industry who can secure an NAAA member sponsor.
scholarships.needs: An NAAA member sponsor, a 750+ word essay or 5+ minute multimedia presentation on the year's topic, a cited source, applicant photo and bio, and sponsor/contact information.

scholarships.name: Breakthrough Junior Challenge
scholarships.award: $250,000 postsecondary scholarship; additional prizes for the student's teacher and school science lab
scholarships.eligibility: Students worldwide who are age 13–18 during the 2026 competition and can create a two-minute video explaining a difficult physics, mathematics, or life-sciences idea.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Open now; submit the application and video by September 15, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific. Peer reviews are due September 30.
scholarships.whyFit: A reach opportunity for a Toppenish student who loves science and can explain a complex idea clearly and creatively on video.
scholarships.needs: Online profile, age-verification document, a public YouTube video of two minutes or less, application materials, and peer reviews of at least five other entries.

scholarships.name: Yakima Federal Award for Academic Excellence
scholarships.award: Up to 80 awards of $2,500 in the 2026 cycle
scholarships.eligibility: Graduating high-school seniors who live in Yakima, Benton, Franklin, or Kittitas County, rank in the top 10% of their class, and plan to enroll at an accredited college, community college, university, or technical school.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Expected to open around February 2027 based on the 2026 cycle; last year's deadline was April 20. The new date may change.
scholarships.whyFit: Toppenish is in Yakima County, and two Toppenish seniors received this award in the 2026 cycle. It is a strong planning target for students in the top 10% of their class with leadership and service.
scholarships.needs: One-page motivation letter, two recommendations, school verification of top-10% standing, and proof of college, community-college, university, or technical-school acceptance when requested.

scholarships.name: Northwest Farm Credit Diversity Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors or current college students from underrepresented groups who are pursuing a profession or technical career that will positively influence Northwest agriculture.
scholarships.expectedWindow: The sponsor describes this as an annual program with a March 1 deadline. Begin checking for the 2027 application in January; the new date may change.
scholarships.whyFit: A strong agriculture or technical-career planning opportunity for Toppenish students from underrepresented backgrounds whose education plans connect to Northwest agriculture.
scholarships.needs: Current sponsor application, education and career plan, activities and leadership history, and the supporting materials requested for the 2027 cycle.

scholarships.name: Filipino American Community of Yakima Valley Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Filipino American Community of Yakima Valley
scholarships.award: See the current-cycle announcement
scholarships.eligibility: A Toppenish senior of Filipino descent may qualify when a parent or guardian has been a Filipino American Community of Yakima Valley member for at least two years.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Tentatively expected in May 2027 based on a dated Class of 2024 school post. The scholarship, opening date, deadline, award, and requirements are not guaranteed and will be updated if a new cycle is released.
scholarships.whyFit: A narrow but valuable local opportunity for a Toppenish student whose family meets the membership requirement.
scholarships.needs: Prepare proof of Filipino heritage and parent or guardian membership, plus the application materials named in the new-cycle announcement.
scholarships.sourceNote: Historical planning source: a school-hosted Class of 2024 post dated May 13, 2024 listed a May 24, 2024 deadline. This is prior-cycle information, not a current application.

scholarships.name: The Isidro Scholarship
scholarships.award: See the current-cycle announcement
scholarships.eligibility: A Toppenish High School senior living in a single-parent household may qualify if the scholarship returns with similar requirements.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Tentatively expected in May 2027 based on a dated Class of 2024 school post. The scholarship, opening date, deadline, award, and requirements are not guaranteed and will be updated if a new cycle is released.
scholarships.whyFit: This was created for a specific Toppenish student experience, so it is worth keeping visible even though only a small number of students may qualify.
scholarships.needs: Watch for the new-cycle application and prepare the personal, school, and household information it requests.
scholarships.sourceNote: Historical planning source: a school-hosted Class of 2024 post dated May 13, 2024 listed a May 15, 2024 deadline. This is prior-cycle information, not a current application.

scholarships.name: WASWD Walt Canter Water and Wastewater Scholarship
scholarships.organization: Washington Association of Sewer & Water Districts
scholarships.award: See the current-cycle application
scholarships.eligibility: A Washington resident pursuing college or utility-operator training may qualify; prior cycles also included employees, elected officials, and family members connected to a WASWD member district.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Tentatively expected to open in March 2027 with an April 30, 2027 planning deadline, based on previous official cycles. The new dates, award, and requirements are not guaranteed.
scholarships.whyFit: Toppenish students pursuing water, wastewater, utility operations, environmental systems, or related college and technical training may benefit.
scholarships.needs: Prepare the current sponsor application, education or training plan, school information, and any connection to a WASWD member district requested in the new cycle.
scholarships.sourceNote: Historical planning sources: WASWD's official 2024 application and its official 2025 program update. The most recent verified prior deadline was April 30, 2025.

scholarships.name: John & Terry Brearley Toppenish Rotary Scholarship
scholarships.award: Prior cycle offered at least two $2,000 awards; current amount not confirmed
scholarships.eligibility: A Toppenish High School senior may qualify if the local Rotary scholarship returns with similar requirements.
scholarships.expectedWindow: Tentatively expected in April or May 2027 based on a dated Class of 2024 school post. The scholarship, opening date, deadline, award, and requirements are not guaranteed.
scholarships.whyFit: This is a local Toppenish award with a much smaller applicant pool than most national scholarships.
scholarships.needs: Prepare a current transcript, activities and service list, short personal statement, and any recommendations requested by the new application.
scholarships.sourceNote: Historical planning source: a school-hosted Class of 2024 post dated April 30, 2024 listed at least two $2,000 awards and a May 22, 2024 deadline. This is prior-cycle information.

scholarships.name: Toppenish School District Administration Scholarship
scholarships.award: See the current-cycle announcement
scholarships.eligibility: A Toppenish High School senior may qualify if the district administration scholarship returns for the 2026–27 school year.
scholarships.expectedWindow: A dated Class of 2024 school post shows that this opportunity existed, but no prior deadline was preserved. Watch for a possible April or May 2027 return; no deadline is being predicted.
scholarships.whyFit: A district-based opportunity may have a very small eligible pool, so it is useful for Toppenish seniors to know it may return.
scholarships.needs: Watch for the current school announcement and prepare the transcript, activities, essay, and recommendations requested in the new cycle.
scholarships.sourceNote: Historical planning source: a school-hosted Class of 2024 post dated April 23, 2024. The archived post did not preserve an application deadline, so this card does not invent one.
